mechanism_narrative: A higher federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) increases discount rates applied to equity cash flows, compressing valuations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days regardless of economic conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of observations when FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.0%, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) rises above 4.5% in a 3-month window, it triggers aggressive monetary tightening that suppresses corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates dual monetary tightening and labor market deterioration, significantly depressing S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: The joint rise in FEDFUNDS and UNRATE fails to produce negative returns in more than 60% of cases, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.01.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment rate (UNRATE) falls below 3.5% in a 3-month window, it signals a tight labor market that boosts corporate profit margins, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE < 3.5%, or Rank IC < 0.02 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: In recessionary regimes (GDPC1 growth < 0.5% and UNRATE > 4.0%), a rising unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals worsening economic conditions, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: Within recessionary regimes, rising UNRATE fails to produce negative returns in more than 60% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.01 for the signal.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of retail sales (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer spending that supports corporate revenue growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days regardless of economic cycle.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of observations when RSAFS exceeds its 50th percentile, or Rank IC < 0.02 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in retail sales (RSAFS) and industrial production (INDPRO) signals robust economic activity that significantly boosts equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 days.
failure_condition: The joint rise in RSAFS and INDPRO fails to yield positive returns in more than 60% of cases, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.01.

mechanism_narrative: In supply-constrained regimes (INDPRO growth < 0.3% and CPIAUCSL growth > 3.0%), a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals worsening supply chain conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: Within supply-constrained regimes, falling INDPRO fails to produce negative returns in more than 60% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.01 for the signal.
